<user_query>
In repo C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell, find why the main app UI leaves empty black space on the right when the window is wide/ultrawide. Search for:
- max-width constraints on root layout containers
- fixed width layouts in App.jsx or main shell components
- window resize / bounds handling
- WorkspacePanelsLayer, workbench, rails layout
- CSS classes like max-w-, w-[fixed], container width caps

Return: specific files and line ranges causing width cap, recommended fix approach matching existing patterns. Read actual source files, not dist.
</user_query>

Searching the NeuralShell repo for layout width constraints and shell components that could cause the ultrawide empty space.

[REDACTED]

Narrowing the search to source files and reading the main layout components.

[REDACTED]

## Summary

There is **no root shell max-width** — the app root is full viewport. The empty black/dark area on ultrawide comes from a **two-layer width cap**: side rails are hard-capped at ~480–500px, and the center column’s **chat UI is capped with `max-w-* mx-auto`**, so extra horizontal space stays as bare `shell.canvas` / `bg-slate-950` (#020812).

---

## Root layout (no cap here)

The outer shell is intentionally full-screen:

```3270:3271:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
    return (
        <motion.div className="h-screen w-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-200 flex flex-col overflow-hidden font-sans selection:bg-cyan-500/30">
```

(Actual file uses `<motion.div>` or `<motion.div>` — line 3271 shows `div` with `h-screen w-screen`.)

Workspace row is also full flex:

```3378:3380:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
            <motion.div className="flex-1 flex min-h-0 overflow-hidden relative">
                {USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL ? (
                    <PrimaryWorkspaceRegion
```

`PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` is `flex-1 flex min-h-0`; center `MultiWorkspace` gets `className="flex-1"` — structurally correct for full width.

`index.css` / `tailwind.config.js` set canvas to `#020812` — that’s what reads as “empty black.”

---

## Primary causes (with line ranges)

### 1. Hard rail width caps (side columns stop growing)

```124:129:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
const DEFAULT_THREAD_RAIL_WIDTH = 288;
const DEFAULT_WORKBENCH_RAIL_WIDTH = 288;
const THREAD_RAIL_MIN_WIDTH = 236;
const WORKBENCH_RAIL_MIN_WIDTH = 236;
const THREAD_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH = 480;
const WORKBENCH_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH = 500;
```

Viewport-based caps are computed but **clamped back down** by those constants:

```821:828:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
    const inlineThreadRailMaxWidth = React.useMemo(() => {
        const viewportCap = Math.floor(viewportWidth * (layoutMode === 'expanded' ? 0.34 : 0.42));
        return clampRailWidth(viewportCap, THREAD_RAIL_MIN_WIDTH, THREAD_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH);
    }, [layoutMode, viewportWidth]);
    const inlineWorkbenchRailMaxWidth = React.useMemo(() => {
        const viewportCap = Math.floor(viewportWidth * 0.34);
        return clampRailWidth(viewportCap, WORKBENCH_RAIL_MIN_WIDTH, WORKBENCH_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH);
    }, [viewportWidth]);
```

On a 3440px ultrawide window, `viewportCap` ≈ 1169px but rails stay ≤500px; the center `flex-1` absorbs ~2.8k px.

Rails render fixed pixel width:

```66:70:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\ThreadRail.jsx
        <aside
            data-testid="thread-rail"
            className="shrink-0 border-r border-white/5 flex flex-col bg-slate-950/50 backdrop-blur-xl z-20 overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: `${railWidth}px` }}
```

```67:70:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\WorkbenchRail.jsx
        <aside
            data-testid="workbench-rail"
            className="shrink-0 border-l border-white/5 flex flex-col bg-slate-950/50 backdrop-blur-xl z-20"
            style={{ width: `${railWidth}px` }}
```

### 2. Center chat content max-width + centering (main visual “dead zone”)

**Active path** (`USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL = true` at line 282) uses `MultiWorkspace`:

Empty / hero state capped at `max-w-6xl mx-auto` (1152px):

```236:237:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MultiWorkspace.jsx
        <div className="flex min-h-full w-full items-start justify-center px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
            <motion.div className="w-full max-w-6xl space-y-6 animate-fade-up">
```

Follow-ups capped at `max-w-3xl mx-auto`:

```157:158:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\SmartSuggest.jsx
    return (
        <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-1 pb-2 pt-1">
```

Messages use percentage caps (not full column):

```169:169:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MultiWorkspace.jsx
            <div className={`flex flex-col gap-1 max-w-[85%] ${isUser ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}>
```

**Legacy path** (`USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL = false`) — `WorkspacePanel.jsx` has many `max-w-5xl mx-auto` blocks (composer, chips, input wrapper), e.g.:

```735:735:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\WorkspacePanel.jsx
                <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto mb-3 flex gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 no-scrollbar opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300">
```

```1010:1012:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\WorkspacePanel.jsx
                    className={cn(
                        'relative group max-w-5xl mx-auto transition-all duration-200',
                        isDragOver && 'ring-2 ring-violet-400/40 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(139,92,246,0.15)]',
```

On ultrawide, the center column is wide but UI stays ~1024–1152px centered → large dark margins, often most noticeable on the **right** (left already has thread rail).

### 3. Window resize / bounds (tracks width correctly; doesn’t cap UI)

Renderer resize handler:

```858:868:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
    React.useEffect(() => {
        const handleResize = () => {
            const nextWidth = Number.isFinite(window.innerWidth)
                ? window.innerWidth
                : DEFAULT_VIEWPORT_WIDTH;
            setViewportWidth(nextWidth);
        };
        handleResize();
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
        return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    }, []);
```

Layout breakpoints (not width caps):

```111:113:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
const DEFAULT_VIEWPORT_WIDTH = 1440;
const EXPANDED_LAYOUT_MIN = 1280;
const BALANCED_LAYOUT_MIN = 1080;
```

Main process opens window at ~90% of work area (not full monitor unless maximized):

```1438:1451:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\main.js
function getAdaptiveWindowMetrics(display) {
  ...
  const width = clampWindowMetric(
    Math.round(workWidth * (compactDisplay ? 0.96 : 0.9)),
    minWidth,
    maxWidth
  );
```

That affects **window vs monitor**, not in-window right gutter.

### 4. WorkspacePanelsLayer / workbench / rails

**Not the main-shell culprit.** `WorkspacePanelsLayer` is a fixed right drawer with intentional modal caps:

```27:28:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\WorkspacePanelsLayer.jsx
                className={`fixed right-0 top-0 bottom-0 z-[139] bg-slate-950 border-l border-cyan-400/20 shadow-[-16px_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)] flex flex-col ${
                    wide ? 'w-full max-w-2xl' : 'w-full max-w-md'
```

Inline workbench visibility in recovery shell:

```805:811:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx
    const recoveryShowInlineWorkbenchRail = USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL
        ? layoutMode !== 'focused'
        : showInlineWorkbenchRail;
    ...
    const recoveryShowInlineWorkbenchRailPanel = recoveryShowInlineWorkbenchRail
        && !recoveryWorkbenchRailCollapsed
        && workbenchRailChromeVisible;
```

If workbench is collapsed/hidden via adaptive layout, the right edge is **only** uncapped center canvas — amplifying the empty look.

### 5. Decorative fixed-width visuals (minor)

`MoodBackdrop` auroras are fixed 800px / 440px centered — cosmetic only:

```22:36:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MoodBackdrop.jsx
            <div
                className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 pointer-events-none animate-mood-aurora"
                style={{
                    width: 800,
                    height: 340,
```

---

## Recommended fix (match existing patterns)

### A. Scale rail max widths with viewport (reuse `clampRailWidth` + `viewportWidth`)

Replace fixed `THREAD_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH` / `WORKBENCH_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH` usage in the `inline*RailMaxWidth` memos with something like:

```js
const railMaxForViewport = (pct, absMax) =>
  clampRailWidth(Math.floor(viewportWidth * pct), MIN, absMax);
```

Raise absolute ceiling on large viewports (e.g. 640–720 above 1920px), or derive max from `viewportCap` without clamping to 500. Existing preset toolbar (`LayoutControlBar` + `RAIL_SIZE_PRESETS`) and drag-resize (`updateRailWidth`, pointer handlers ~3205–3242) already follow this model — extend it rather than adding a new layout system.

Also wire `updateRailWidth` (3053–3065) to use `inline*RailMaxWidth` instead of static 480/500 so manual resize matches ultrawide caps.

### B. Relax center content caps responsively (match `2xl:` pattern already on messages)

In `MultiWorkspace.jsx` / `SmartSuggest.jsx` / `ChatSummaryBar.jsx`:

- Change `max-w-6xl mx-auto` → `w-full max-w-6xl 2xl:max-w-7xl 3xl:max-w-[90rem] mx-auto` (or drop `mx-auto` and use `px-6 lg:px-10` only).
- Same for legacy `WorkspacePanel.jsx` `max-w-5xl mx-auto` clusters if that path stays.

Pattern already exists:

```686:686:C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\WorkspacePanel.jsx
                                <motion.div data-testid="chat-message" ... className="max-w-[85%] 2xl:max-w-[75%] ml-auto ...
```

### C. Optional ultrawide rail preset

Extend `RAIL_SIZE_PRESETS` (241–258 in `App.jsx`) with a viewport-gated preset (e.g. `wide` uses 340 today; add `ultrawide: { thread: 420, workbench: 420 }` when `viewportWidth >= 1920`) and surface it in `LayoutControlBar` — same UX as existing HUD/Standard/Spacious buttons.

### D. Verify workbench isn’t hidden

If the gap is specifically “no right rail at all,” check adaptive layout storage (`useAdaptiveLayoutChrome.js`, key `neuralshell_adaptive_layout_v1`) for `workbench-rail: false` — that removes the right column entirely while center still flex-expands.

---

## Quick diagnosis checklist

| Symptom | Likely source |
|--------|----------------|
| Dark band inside window, content ~1k px wide centered | `max-w-5xl` / `max-w-6xl` / `max-w-3xl` in center column |
| Rails stay ~288–500px on 34" monitor | `THREAD_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH` / `WORKBENCH_RAIL_MAX_WIDTH` in `App.jsx` 128–129 |
| No workbench column at all on wide window | `recoveryShowInlineWorkbenchRailPanel` false (collapsed or adaptive layout) |
| Black outside app window | Electron `getAdaptiveWindowMetrics` 90% initial width (`main.js` 1447–1450) |

**Bottom line:** The shell fills the window; ultrawide emptiness is from **fixed rail ceilings + centered chat max-widths**, not a missing `w-full` on the root. Fix by scaling rail max via existing `viewportWidth`/`clampRailWidth` and widening/removing `max-w-* mx-auto` in the center column using the same responsive Tailwind approach already used on chat bubbles.
